message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2 in `npm test`.

The failing test was wrong, not the code. The test asserted `withVat(250) === 301`, but 250 × 1.2 is exactly 300, so no rounding rule gives 301. I changed that expectation to 300 in `test/vat.test.js`. I left `src/vat.js` unchanged, since it already does what its comment describes.

I didn't commit the change.
